title: Ember Keep Descent
description: Ember Keep Descent is an original dungeon adventure. a dungeon crawl down a volcanic keep, where a lone warden fights ember sprites and magma hounds to reach the vault exit.
body:
Ember Keep Descent is an original dungeon adventure. a dungeon crawl down a volcanic keep, where a lone warden fights ember sprites and magma hounds to reach the vault exit.

The rules are: a volcanic dungeon run with ember monsters guarding the exit on a small grid map. Walls block movement, monsters must be attacked from an adjacent square, treasure adds fifty points, and reaching the exit wins the run. Each attack deals twenty-five damage, and a monster that survives hits back for ten health, so the player starts with one hundred health and must spend it wisely.

The winning habit is patience at the monster's edge. Attack, check the health, and only step forward once the square is clear. Treasure on the route is free points, but treasure behind a live monster is a trap for the greedy.
